An operator holding 115 idle keys hence pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 30% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
